description: Per-DISCLOSURE feed of politician trades: one item per congressional STOCK Act periodic transaction report (PTR) or executive-branch OGE Form 278-T that contains at least one trade whose bracket LOWER bound is >= minAmount. Each item carries the politician, filing link, filing delay, and ALL trades of the report sorted largest bracket first, with qualifyingTradeCount for how many clear the threshold. Built for polling: pass the returned nextCursor back as `since` and each disclosure is returned exactly once (for the same minAmount and kinds); keep nextCursor even when items is empty, and call again at once when hasMore is true. Without `since` only disclosures that became complete in the last 48h are returned. A report is emitted only after no new row of it has arrived for a settle window (~8h), so items lag the filing by hours; a report that GROWS materially afterwards (+25 trades or +20%) is emitted once more with a higher `revision`, and `replacesPrevious: true` when you already had it — replace it by `id`. filingDelayDays (longest lag), isLateFiling (>45 days) and lateTradeCount EXCLUDE trades with transactionDateSuspect=true: a date lagging its own otherwise on-time report by ~one year is a probable mistyped year upstream, listed as filed and counted in suspectDateCount — never quote it as a filing lag. owner null means the filing did not state one ("Not stated"), NEVER "Self". Render amountRange (the filed bracket); amountMin null means the bracket was not parsed (never $0), amountMax null means "Over $50,000,000" or unparsed, ticker null means a non-equity asset.

kinds.description: Which disclosure kinds to include (default: both). 'congressional' = STOCK Act PTRs (Senate + House), 'executive' = OGE 278-T (Cabinet-level officials).

minAmount.description: USD threshold compared to each trade's bracket lower bound (default: 50001). A disclosure qualifies when ANY of its trades meets it.

since.description: Opaque cursor: the nextCursor from a previous call, verbatim. Omit only on the first call.

name: get_politician_disclosures
title: Get Politician Disclosures (Feed)
